about: The host moves of Sirius in Turm und Genossin, der Talk (plan "TWENTY ONE Radio", P16; user 2026-10-13: the host's phrases must be very extensive for lots of variance). Written for the show as a parody of an interrupting talk show host's STYLE (dramaturgy rule host-interrupts, resources/data/voice/talkshow.json); none of them is a quote of a real person, none names a real host. TalkShow::hostMoves() offers a rotating sample per episode (one per group first, the ones offered longest ago first) and never a move said on air within `tv.commentary.repeat_hours` (SpokenMemory); the host may also invent new ones in the same style. P20 (user 2026-10-13: "Und der Moderator stellt keine Fragen … Der Moderator ist Lanz, und der moderiert nicht durch Fragen?"): the groups nachfrage, umformulieren, hypothetisch, entweder_oder, konfrontieren, ausreden_dann_fragen, sticheln and festnageln are questions to a guest by name, after the question techniques of talkshow.json (host-asks, controversial-interview, closed-questions, reflexive-questions, loaded-questions).
